target.title: refactor: consolidate duplicate helper exports
target.body:
Closes #105996

## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a maintenance problem where identical helper names in core and workspace packages hid copied or incompatible implementations. The copies could drift while callers had no signal that, for example, one duration parser throws and accepts composites while the cron parser returns `null`, requires a unit, floors values, and rejects non-positive results.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Moves shared string coercion, duration parsing, and agent-id normalization into `@openclaw/normalization-core`.
- Derives normalization-core source/native aliases from its package exports, retaining packaged-dist fallback instead of another copied subpath inventory.
- Deletes memory-host-sdk's copied string helper module and adds the already-valid package dependency to media-generation-core.
- Keeps Gateway transcript whitespace preservation under the explicit `readNonBlankStringPreservingWhitespace` contract.
- Renames the cron parser to `parsePositiveCronDurationMs` and the standalone memory path helper to `resolveMemoryHostUserPath`.
- Consolidates core's two `resolveUserPath` definitions in `src/infra/home-dir.ts`; `src/utils.ts` remains a compatibility re-export.

The memory-host package can depend on normalization-core, so coercion primitives now import it directly. It cannot import core `src/**` without reversing the package boundary; standalone home/config/SQLite/secret helpers therefore remain package-owned where they have narrower contracts. Existing plugin/runtime facades and public compatibility exports were not renamed opportunistically. Sibling-owned `retryAsync` and `formatErrorMessage` work was intentionally untouched.

## User Impact

No intended user-visible behavior change. Maintainers get one implementation for compatible helpers, explicit names for incompatible contracts, and 166 fewer non-test lines (`+228/-394`).

## Evidence

- Exact-head Blacksmith Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kxcy8tnkmp19kvj2et35xfw6`: full `pnpm build`, formatting and LOC-ratchet proof, and 1,118 focused normalization, memory-host, Gateway, CLI, routing, path, plugin-resolver, and packaged-alias tests; green after rebasing onto current main.
- Initial hosted CI feedback was fixed before landing: formatting, the tsdown LOC ratchet, and native/package alias coverage. `tsdown.config.ts` is now five lines smaller than the PR base.
- Per-cluster Codex autoreview runs: clean after accepted whitespace-preservation fix; final branch review recorded separately in the landing proof.
- `git diff --check`: clean.

## Actionable duplicate clusters

| Cluster | Baseline definitions | Resolution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| string coercion | `normalizeOptionalString`, lowercasing/list/unique variants across normalization-core, memory-host-sdk, media-generation-core, Gateway | normalization-core canonical; Gateway's distinct preserve-whitespace behavior renamed |
| duration parsing | CLI throwing/options parser, memory-host copy, cron positive/null parser | normalization-core canonical; cron contract renamed |
| agent id | routing and memory-host copies | normalization-core canonical and re-exported |
| user path | two core definitions plus memory-host standalone copy | `home-dir.ts` canonical; core re-export; package-only contract renamed |

## Full baseline enumeration table

Generated at `2ecd485cd5f41f8884117eac91e9c57fbe7c4c98` with exported `function`/`const` definitions under `src/` and `packages/`, grouped by name and deduplicated by module. Re-exports do not match the defining-expression scan; `*.runtime.ts(x)` facades are excluded as requested. The full 417-cluster table is below, including deliberately unrelated domain-local names and test helpers left unchanged.
